'''Iktotch''' was the homeworld of the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]]. It was the third [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Iktotchon/Legends|Iktotchon]].

==Description==
The satellite of the planet Iktotchon, Iktotch was the rocky [[Moon/Legends|moon]] upon which the hardy [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Species/Legends|species]] evolved and developed a rugged society. The moon itself was considered inhospitable by galactic standards, due to the strong sand-and-gravel windstorms that buffeted the barren landscape. The Iktotchi developed a heightened [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] to survive on the moon, with innate [[Precognition/Legends|precognitive]] skills that allowed them to predict a storm's approach and avoid the damaging winds.<ref name="NoP" />

==History==
Developing a civilized culture early in galactic history with the assistance of the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]], the Iktotchi established cities across Iktotchi that straddled the jagged peaks of their world. Part of the [[Kwa holdings]], the Iktotchi society was based around the species' innate ability to sense [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and predict the effects of the fierce storms that affected the moon. Circa [[35,000 BBY]], a [[Tho Yor]] visited the moon and a group of Iktotchi boarded the pyramid ship. Transferring the Iktotchi and many other passengers on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] planet of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], these Iktotchi went on to form the [[Je'daii Order]], the precursor of the galaxy-spanning [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="DotJ" />

Life continued on Iktotch long after the Kwa stopped visiting and the Tho Yor departure became a distant memory. Despite the high winds of the moon, the Iktotchi developed [[airship]]s before they developed [[Boat/Legends|marine vehicles]] or wheeled or treaded ground vehicles. Predicting the rise of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], ancient Iktotchi carved the [[Republic crest|crest]] of the Republic into a [[Republic Seal Mountain/Legends|mountainside]] on their [[Iktotch's largest continent|largest continent]] where they predicted [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] would land. Arriving on the planet to an expectant crowd circa [[3500 BBY]], the Republic scouts were extremely surprised to see that these beings had already prepared for their arrival and set up public events several weeks prior.<ref name="AA" /><ref name="NoP" /> Alerted to the discovery of Iktotch by the Republic, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], which already had dealt with the species on Tython, took an interest in the moon's people, establishing a [[Jedi Temple (Iktotch)|Jedi Temple]] as one of the first offworld establishments on the world.<ref name="AA" /> The Jedi began inducting powerful Iktotchi into the Order and conducting studies on the world. Some Jedi and scholars speculated that the moon itself was a massive [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], though admitted that the phenomenon rarely encompassed an entire moon. The Jedi also found it peculiar that the farther from Iktotch an Iktotchi traveled, the weaker their connection to the Force grew.<ref name="NoP" />

While the Iktotchi throughout the galaxy began to return to Iktotch in the years preceding the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] due to their precognitive skills, most failed to predict the fall of the Republic and the Jedi Order due to the [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] veil of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="NoP" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the war, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] thwarted a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Battle of Iktotch|invasion]] of the planet.<ref name="Heavy Metal Jedi">{{CWACite|1|Heavy Metal Jedi}}</ref>

Beginning to construct orbital colonies during the war to accommodate the influx of immigrant Iktotchi returning to their ancestral homeworld, the moon saw only darkness in the future.<ref name="AA" /> When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to power, the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] immediately ordered that the moon be [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] to prevent the Iktotchi from threatening the stability of the Empire. Visitors to the system required permits, and additional waivers to land on the moon. While the Iktotchi were prohibited from leaving the moon, many Iktotchi offworld returned home to avoid the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|civil war]] which they predicted would affect other occupied worlds more directly then their isolated moon. Because no [[Governor/Legends|Imperial Governor]] was installed, the citizens of Iktotch were free to live as they wished, but were also forced to go without galactic support should they suffer any planetary crises. [[Pilot/Legends|Pilots]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] frequently broke the blockade to smuggle in items not permitted through official channels, as wells as black market material. Others sought out the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to help promote the forthcoming change in power.<ref name="NoP" />

When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] formed in the wake of the collapse of the Empire, the Iktotchi were among its founders, and a vocal force for peace. Despite their precognitive skills, the Iktotchi were caught offguard when the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] the galaxy, as they were disconnected from the Force.<ref name="AA" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' shows in the Galactic Explorations map that Iktotchi was discovered sometime between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] to [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], however whether this is the planet or just the system has yet to be stated. In an email, [[Jason Fry]] stated that it's possible the Iktotchi and their system were most likely known much earlier than the date which is stated in ''The New Essential Guide to Alien Species''.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:Jason Fry email 1.png|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2012-06-26}}</ref> An Iktotchi is seen in [[Knights of the Old Republic 45|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 45]] set in [[3963 BBY]].
